fusions.name: Draw It Out
fusions.desc: Pulls a drawing strand out through the target that deals 16 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Bitter Wick
fusions.desc: Casts a soaked strand that deals 10 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Common Ligature
fusions.desc: Draws up to 2 poison conditions out of you and out of each of your allies, and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Dose Returned
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.
